comment: Golden vectors for firmware-telemetry/v2 Device Mode. Each case is a signed capability manifest message whose manifest is otherwise valid under v1. A consumer of this version must accept every case in 'cases' and refuse every case in 'reject_cases' with the declared reason. Each case is judged on its own against verifier_context, as the first manifest registered for that provisioning anchor. Signed with a disclosed TEST-ONLY seed, the same one the fault corpus discloses: never provision it.

reasons.invalid_device_mode: device_mode is not one of the four values, including a value of another JSON type, or is not the value the manifest's channels and actions determine

cases.name: sensor_node
cases.note: one metering channel and no action

cases.name: sensor_node_two_sources
cases.note: every channel whose source is not foreign_device meters, whatever its source or protocol

cases.name: bridge_node
cases.note: one bridged channel and no action

cases.name: mixed_metering_bridged
cases.note: metering and bridged channels, no action

cases.name: mixed_metering_action
cases.note: an actuator that declares the channel its interlock reads is mixed

cases.name: mixed_bridged_action
cases.note: a bridged channel and an action

cases.name: mixed_all_three
cases.note: all three roles; the bridged channel comes first, so no position decides the mode

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_unknown_string
reject_cases.note: a string outside the four values, over arrays that make the device a sensor_node

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_wrong_case
reject_cases.note: values compare exactly; a case variant of sensor_node is no value

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_integer
reject_cases.note: device_mode is a JSON string; an integer is another type

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_null
reject_cases.note: null is present but names no mode

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_boolean
reject_cases.note: device_mode is a JSON string; a boolean is another type

reject_cases.name: reject_sensor_node_with_action
reject_cases.note: a metering device that declares an action is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_sensor_node_with_bridged_channel
reject_cases.note: a channel whose source is foreign_device is bridged, so the arrays make this a bridge_node

reject_cases.name: reject_bridge_node_with_metering_channel
reject_cases.note: a bridge that also meters is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_mixed_single_role
reject_cases.note: mixed needs more than one role; metering alone is a sensor_node

reject_cases.name: reject_actuator_node_over_mixed
reject_cases.note: an actuator that declares a channel is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_actuator_node_no_channels
reject_cases.note: the mode agrees with the arrays, so the empty channels alone refuse it; actuator_node is never accepted under this version
